_help: This is the ONLY file you need to edit to search for something else. Restart the helper after changing it (node src/server.js). Everything here is case-insensitive.
_queries: Each one is a separate Facebook Marketplace search, run once per city. Keep this list short: 6 queries x 2 cities = 12 searches = roughly 5 minutes of a sweep. Facebook search is fuzzy, so broad terms work.
_cities: Facebook city slugs the searches are centred on. Two at 100 mi covers a 100 mi circle around home; more cities mostly means overlap.
_maxDistanceMiles: Listings further than this from home are rejected. Distance is worked out from the city on the card (no exact addresses).
_maxMileage: Odometer ceiling. A listing over this is Rejected; one whose mileage cannot be read becomes Needs Review rather than a silent Match.
_mustContainAny: A listing is only a Match if its title or description contains at least one of these. Leave the list empty [] to accept anything the searches return.
_mustNotContain: Any of these anywhere in the title or description rejects the listing outright.
_minYear: Set to null to ignore the year. The Macan launched for the 2015 model year.
_home: Where distances are measured from. Leave null to use HOME_LAT / HOME_LON from .env.
_requireKeywordOnCard: true = a search result is only opened if its card contains one of the mustContainAny words (or, if that list is empty, the search term). Facebook search is fuzzy and brand words match everything by that brand. Set false if your product's cards are too terse to name it.
